ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels and 30% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous zones occupying the interior of both lobes. These are bisected by a low-intensity dark vertical band at the peduncle. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border around the perimeter, with increased mottling and high-frequency speckling along the leading edges and trailing edge margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a wide angle; depth is approximately 5% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration profile. High-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys are visible across the entire trailing edge, with more pronounced indentations located on the distal third of the viewer-right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral symmetrical concave curvature transitioning from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark-pixel clusters visible near the trailing edge of the viewer-right lobe and speckling along the lower margin of the viewer-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, near-vertical dark linear disruption is visible in the lower-central region of the viewer-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, irregular indentation (notch) is visible on the trailing edge of the viewer-left lobe approximately midway between the notch and tip.
